fact: The Communications (SIM Registration) (Amendment) Regulations, 2024, tabled 9 February 2024, introduce a registration category for asylum seekers, recognise their certificate as an official document and let them access communications services while their refugee status is pending, and the Committee allowed them.
title: Report on the Communications (Subscriber Identity Module Registration) (Amendment) Regulations, 2024
publisher: Portfolio Committee on the Prime Minister's Ministries and Departments, Governance, Foreign Relations and Information Cluster, National Assembly of Lesotho
